title: DO facade opens on boot against env.CELL and env.HUB and emits namespaceReady
asA: shelf consumer applying the platform-cloudflare-durable-objects v1.0.0 blueprint on a Workers project using the cf-platform fixture
iWant: one DO facade module (src/do-facade.mjs) that opens against env.CELL and env.HUB on boot, wires the injected event sink and emits a namespaceReady lifecycle event with a metadata-only payload
soThat: boot ordering is observable, the DO namespace seam is a single call site, and the applied project can compose its own bootstrapping around one predictable event

acceptanceCriteria.description: On process boot, the DO facade opens against the elicited DO namespace bindings (env.CELL and env.HUB on the cf-platform fixture), wires the injected event sink and emits a namespaceReady event with a payload of exactly {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp} where key is null, size is 0 and ttl is null. The facade module is the ONLY module in the fixture source tree that dereferences env.CELL or env.HUB.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a Node or Worker process with the do-facade module imported and its factory invoked with the elicited configuration
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and the facade ready() call resolves
acceptanceCriteria.then: a namespaceReady event fires on the injected event sink with the metadata-only payload; no other module dereferences env.CELL or env.HUB

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-4 namespace-unbound: createDoFacade({env:{HUB:{}}, sink}) with env.CELL absent throws a named error kind DO_NAMESPACE_UNBOUND naming the missing binding "CELL" before any sink event fires. No namespaceReady record lands on the sink; the throw is synchronous at factory time so the applying agent sees the failure at boot rather than at first call.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a createDoFacade call whose env object lacks the CELL property
acceptanceCriteria.then: the factory throws DO_NAMESPACE_UNBOUND naming "CELL" and no namespaceReady event fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: F-4 namespace-unbound (hub): createDoFacade({env:{CELL:{}}, sink}) with env.HUB absent throws DO_NAMESPACE_UNBOUND naming the missing binding "HUB" before any sink event fires. The two bindings are checked in a stable order (CELL then HUB) so the error names the first missing binding when both are absent.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a createDoFacade call whose env object lacks the HUB property
acceptanceCriteria.then: the factory throws DO_NAMESPACE_UNBOUND naming "HUB" and no namespaceReady event fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: Invalid sink at boot: the DO facade factory (per TAC-3401.interfaces.createDoFacade) called with a sink argument that is not a function throws DO_FACADE_INVALID_SINK before any binding is dereferenced. Same for the sink omitted or a non-function value; no ready-check runs.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a createDoFacade call whose sink is not a function
acceptanceCriteria.then: the factory throws DO_FACADE_INVALID_SINK and no namespaceReady event fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: Repeat-boot idempotency: two independent createDoFacade({env, sink}).ready() calls on the same env emit two namespaceReady records on the sink, both with identical payload shape {event:"namespaceReady", key:null, size:0, ttl:null, timestamp:<number>}; each record has its own timestamp. No accumulator drift across boots; no cellHandle or hubHandle state leaks between instances.
acceptanceCriteria.given: two independent createDoFacade instances constructed with the same env and sink
acceptanceCriteria.when: ready() is called on each in turn
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sink receives two namespaceReady records with identical shape and independent timestamps

acceptanceCriteria.description: Sole-reader boundary at boot: the src/do-facade.mjs module is the only module in the cf-platform fixture src/ tree that carries the literal substrings "env.CELL" or "env.HUB" outside comments. The wrangler-seam probe (US-33113) routes fetch requests through src/index.mjs which calls createDoFacade({env}) once, and that call site is the only "env" reference on src/index.mjs; the boundary check greps src/*.mjs and asserts the sole-reader claim before boot.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-platform fixture src/ tree at boot time
acceptanceCriteria.when: a recursive scan strips comments and matches "env.CELL" and "env.HUB" against every .mjs file
acceptanceCriteria.then: only src/do-facade.mjs contains the matches; src/index.mjs contains only the createDoFacade({env}) constructor call and no direct env.CELL / env.HUB dereference
